Hi @{author}, thanks for the pull request!

From outside the team Ardia takes bug fixes only: one problem per pull request, closing an issue labelled `bug`, with screenshots or a video under Verification. You can have 3 open at a time. Nothing is closed for missing a rule; the pull request gets a label and waits.

Greptile reviews right away. Fix or answer its comments, resolve the threads, then comment `/recheck` to refresh the `ready` label. The iOS and Android builds and CodeRabbit's review wait until a maintainer starts them; you don't need to push again.

The details are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/blob/{default_branch}/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests).
